scope: Offline matched-work continuation from each hard-control fit. All 32 existing development photos retained, including six unresolved crops. No new count search, MILP routing, crop selection, classification, model training or inference. This does not establish a ten-second end-to-end policy.
question: Do continuous NN scores improve curves when initial cuts, topology and original binary validation targets are fixed?

refinement.paperAudit: finalMaterialAudit at every checkpoint (lattice plus independent polygon offsets)
refinement.identicalSheets: preserve when the starting pair is exactly identical
refinement.cfg: saved final seed settings; all physical limits and matching penalty unchanged

controls: Verify parent source hashes, native probability hashes and raw source masks.
Every observed pixel must have the same hard decision under both fitting fields, including the strict >0.5 checkpoint convention.
Reconstruct both starts from the same exported geometry and require exactly equal nested curve coordinates, phase, slit counts and independently rendered seed mask.
Both methods compute all 160 gradient steps, with no clock deadline, early stopping, topology changes or repeated-block skipping.
Checkpoints and final exports retain geometry, paper, original image and feature requirements. Preserve every raw outcome, including failures.
No finish() repair or new matching-sheet search after the measured continuation. Record raw proposals separately from whether they improve the saved seed.
Independently render and convert every exported proposal to editable SVG; inspect every photo, seed and proposed weave.
evaluation: Rotate arm order by original photo index. Report all 32 photos, raw pass/fail counts, same-denominator errors, new/lost passes, seed versus continued geometry and timings. A useful improvement must survive editable conversion. No per-photo temperature, step-count or learning-rate selection after inspection.
limitations: These repeatedly inspected development photos are not an untouched holdout.
The score scale is inherited from training; real-photo calibration is unestablished.
Initial cuts are prior fitted candidates rather than ground truth; preserving their topology may limit recovery.
The fixed 160-step continuation adds compute after the original search; do not report it as a faster end-to-end solver.
Exact shared cubics remain tied. The stock refiner can straighten spans or project short returns, identically configured in both arms.
